class: NATIVE OBSERVED: real X11 keys/clicks through ibus-hangul 1.5.5 + ibus 1.5.33 + WebKitGTK 2.54.1 (Xvfb). 18 timing variants × hwp/hwpx per environment; environment axes new this round: IBUS_ENABLE_SYNC_MODE=1/2, hangul use-event-forwarding=true, plus default with the new dispatch probe.
probe: at an empty compositionend a MessageChannel task is posted; finalBeforePostedTask counts finals dispatched before that task ran (no other task, e.g. a Ctrl+Z keydown, can interleave). 'Unidentified' is the IME-filtered (229) keydown of the Ctrl press itself.
